mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the recession deepens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary supply shock (indicated by INDPRO below 100), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as production cuts and inventory adjustments weigh on corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 550,000 units (HOUST < 550.0) signals a severe housing market contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the recession deepens.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of near-zero interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%), the S&P 500 typically experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates economic recovery from the recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a severe economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals a deepening recession in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.
